summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a 6-K reporting the completion of a transaction whereby its subsidiary, Banco Itau Colombia S.A., transferred retail banking assets, liabilities, and contracts to Banco de Bogota S.A. at book value. The transaction includes a loan portfolio of approximately BRL 9.7 billion (net of provisions) and deposits of BRL 7.2 billion, with a net transaction value of approximately BRL 2.5 billion. Itau Colombia will now focus on Corporate Banking. The deal has no material impact on regulatory capital. This is a completed divestiture of retail operations, mapped to a US Form 8-K Item 2.01 disclosure. What to watch: the strategic pivot to corporate banking and any further asset rationalization.
